digest.component_or_area: completion verifier context assembly and prefetching
propositions: The completion verifier performs 84-158 redundant file fetch tool calls per run dominated by search_files repeats, with 67-82% of distinct reads already declared in ticket file_impact; prefetching those contents into the context reduces wall-clock time dominated by round-trip latency

The close gate (graph=False) should prefetch only the closing ticket's own file_impact contents plus referencing-commit diffs without walking descendants; the graph=True deep-review path prefetches the subtree-union ranked by cross-descendant frequency and skeleton-compressed over 500 lines

assemble_context (shared by close gate, dimension review, and review workflows) must accept an optional prefetch parameter that defaults to None so non-gate callers remain byte-identical; only gate_ops passes a PrefetchSpec

The prefetched-file-contents section rides the byte-stable fenced ticket_context and cache-reads under the existing automatic message-tail prefix cache; recovery successors inherit the prefetch via the assembled context and include prefetch bytes in physical_context_ceiling so oversized prefetches are trimmed rather than rejected

The completion_verifier.md system prompt must place a trusted anti-anchoring paragraph before the volatile marker that names the prefetch section and instructs confirmation against the working tree only for skeleton-marked files, so successor_system_prompt inherits the same guidance

Live A/B testing on Bedrock (baseline with REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH=0, then prefetch enabled) must achieve at least 20% request count reduction with equal verdict class on discovery-bound tickets; measured coverage of post-clamp own-file_impact on close-path traces must be recorded per entrypoint
